name: Sungrow EnerNeo solid-state transformer 3 MW (MV AC to 800 VDC)
description: Commercial SiC solid-state transformer launched 2026-07-09: converts 10-13.8 kV MV AC directly to 800 VDC. 3 MW standard unit, 1.5 MW minimum block, 3 or 4.5 MW systems. Deliveries 2026-2028 under >130 MW of framework agreements. In the dc_800v chain it replaces the MV/LV transformer plus rectifier.

capacity_w.note: press report: standard unit rated 3 MW (1.5 MW block; 4.5 MW configurable)

efficiency.note: press report: 98.5% conversion efficiency (Bayern Innovativ: 'up to'); load point not stated, treat as peak

input_voltage_v.note: press report: 10-13.8 kV MV AC input

sources.title: Sungrow launches 3 MW solid-state transformer (pv magazine, 2026-07-10)
New transformer for data centers (Bayern Innovativ / E&M powernews, 2026-08-14)
